entries.32.1: नर्मदापुलिने on the sandbank of the Narmada, यत्र where, सुदारुणः the exceedingly fierce, राक्षसेन्द्रः lord of the rakshasas, पुष्पोपहारम् his offering of flowers, कुरुते was making, तस्मात् from that, देशात् place, अदूरतः not far away
entries.32.2: जयताम् among the victorious, श्रेष्ठः the foremost, माहिष्मत्याः of Mahishmati, पतिः the lord, प्रभुः the mighty, अर्जुनः Arjuna, नर्मदातोयम् the water of the Narmada, आश्रितः having entered, नारीभिः सह with his women, क्रीडते was sporting
entries.32.3: तासाम् among them, मध्यगतः standing in the midst, राजा the king, अर्जुनः Arjuna, तदा then, रराज shone, करेणूनाम् of she-elephants, सहस्रस्य of a thousand, मध्यस्थः इव like one standing in the midst, कुञ्जरः an elephant
entries.32.4: सः he, तु indeed, बाहूनाम् of his arms, सहस्रस्य of the thousand, उत्तमम् supreme, बलम् strength, जिज्ञासुः wishing to test, बहुभिः with his many, बाहुभिः arms, वृतः spread across it, नर्मदावेगम् the current of the Narmada, रुरोध dammed
entries.32.5: कार्तवीर्यभुजासक्तम् held back by the arms of Kartavirya, निर्मलम् clear, तत् that, जलम् water, प्राप्य having met them, कूलोपहारम् an assault upon the banks, कुर्वाणम् making, प्रतिस्रोतः against the stream, प्रधावति rushed
entries.32.6: समीननक्रमकरः with its fish and crocodiles and makaras, सपुष्पकुशसंस्तरः with its strewing of flowers and kusha grass, सः that, नर्मदाम्भसः of the water of the Narmada, वेगः flood, प्रावृट्कालः इव like the season of rains, आबभौ appeared
entries.32.7: कार्तवीर्येण by Kartavirya, सम्प्रेषितः इव as though sent forth, सः that, अम्भसः of the water, वेगः surge, रावणस्य of Ravana, सकलम् the whole, पुष्पोपहारम् offering of flowers, जहार ह carried away
entries.32.8: रावणः Ravana, तदा then, अर्धसमाप्तम् half completed, तम् that, नियमम् rite, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, प्रतिकूलाम् turned adverse, प्रियाम् यथा as at a beloved, कान्ताम् the charming, नर्मदाम् Narmada, पश्यते looked
entries.32.9: पश्चिमेन in the west, सागरोद्गारसन्निभम् resembling the surging of the ocean, वर्धन्तम् swelling, अम्भसः of water, वेगम् the flood, तम् that, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पूर्वाम् the eastern, आशाम् quarter, प्रविश्य having entered
entries.32.10: ततः then, अनुभ्रान्तशकुनाम् her birds wheeling after her, स्वभावोपरमे in her natural calm, स्थिताम् settled, निर्विकाराङ्गनाभासाम् appearing like a woman unruffled, नदीम् the river, रावणः Ravana, अपश्यत् beheld
entries.32.11: दशाननः the ten-faced one, सव्येतरकराङ्गुल्या with a finger of his right hand, सशब्दं च and with a snap, सः he, वेगप्रभावम् the cause of the flood, अन्वेष्टुम् to seek out, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, अदिशत् directed
entries.32.12: रावणसन्दिष्टौ commanded by Ravana, तौ those two, भ्रातरौ brothers, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, वीरौ the heroes, व्योमान्तरगतौ passing through the sky, पश्चिमामुखौ facing westward, प्रस्थितौ set out
entries.32.13: तौ those two, रजनीचरौ night-rangers, अर्धयोजनमात्रम् only half a yojana, गत्वा having gone, तोये in the water, सहयोषितम् along with women, क्रीडन्तम् sporting, पुरुषम् a man, पश्येताम् saw
entries.32.14: बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशम् resembling a great sala tree, तोयव्याकुलमूर्धजम् his hair tossed about by the water, मदरक्तान्तनयनम् the corners of his eyes red with wine, मदव्याकुलतेजसम् his lustre unsteady with drink
entries.32.15: बाहुसहस्रेण with his thousand arms, नदीम् the river, रुन्धन्तम् damming, अरिमर्दनम् crusher of foes, पादसहस्रेण with a thousand feet, मेदिनीम् the earth, रुन्धन्तम् इव as if pressing down, गिरिम् a mountain
entries.32.16: बालानाम् young, वरनारीणाम् of lovely women, सहस्रेण by a thousand, समावृतम् surrounded, समदानाम् rutting, करेणूनाम् she-elephants, सहस्रेण इव as by a thousand, कुञ्जरम् an elephant
entries.32.17: राक्षसौ the two rakshasas, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, तम् that, अद्भुततमम् most wondrous sight, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सन्निवृत्तौ having turned back, उपागम्य having approached, तम् that, रावणम् Ravana, अथ then, ऊचतुः said
entries.32.18: राक्षसेश्वर O lord of the rakshasas, बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशः resembling a great sala tree, असौ that one, कः who, अपि indeed, नर्मदाम् the Narmada, रोधवत् like a dam, रुद्ध्वा having blocked, योषितः the women, क्रीडापयति makes to sport
entries.32.19: तेन by him, बाहुसहस्रेण with his thousand arms, सन्निरुद्धजला her waters dammed up, नदी the river, सागरोद्गारसङ्काशान् like the surgings of the ocean, उद्गारान् outbursts, मुहुः again and again, सृजते sends forth
entries.32.20: इत्येवम् in this manner, भाषमाणौ speaking, तौ those two, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, निशाम्य having heard, रावणः Ravana, अर्जुनः it is Arjuna, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, युद्धलालसः eager for battle, प्रययौ set forth
entries.32.21: राक्षसाधिपे the lord of the rakshasas, तस्मिन् when that, रावणे Ravana, अर्जुनाभिमुखे turned toward Arjuna, चण्डः a fierce, पवनः wind, सनादः with a roar, प्रवाति blew, तथा likewise, सुरजाः raising dust
entries.32.22: सकृदेव all at once, सरक्तः reddened, रावः a roar, कृतः was made, घनैः by the clouds, प्रेषितः was sent forth, महोदरमहापार्श्वधूम्राक्षशुकसारणैः by Mahodara and Mahaparshva and Dhumraksha and Shuka and Sarana
entries.32.23: राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of the rakshasas, तु indeed, संवृतः surrounded by them, यत्र where, अर्जुनः Arjuna, तत्र there, अगात् went, अदीर्घेण in no long, कालेन time, सः that, तदा then, बली mighty, राक्षसः rakshasa, अञ्जनप्रभः dark as collyrium, तम् that, भीमम् fearsome, नर्मदाह्रदम् pool of the Narmada, आजगाम reached
entries.32.24: सः he, राक्षसानाम् of the rakshasas, राजा the king, तदा then, तत्र there, वाशिताभिः इव as by she-elephants, द्विपम् an elephant, स्त्रीपरिवृतम् surrounded by women, नरेन्द्रम् the lord of men, अर्जुनम् Arjuna, पश्यते beheld
entries.32.25: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of the rakshasas, रोषात् out of fury, रक्तनयनः his eyes reddened, बलोद्धतः swollen with strength
entries.32.26: इत्येवम् in this manner, गम्भीरया in a deep, गिरा voice, अर्जुनामात्यान् the ministers of Arjuna, आह addressed, अमात्याः O ministers, हैहयस्य of the Haihaya, नृपस्य king, वै indeed, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आख्यात make announcement
entries.32.27: रावणो नाम Ravana by name, राक्षसः a rakshasa, युद्धार्थी seeking battle, समनुप्राप्तः has arrived, रावणस्य of Ravana, वचः the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अथ then, अर्जुनस्य of Arjuna, ते those, मन्त्रिणः counsellors, सायुधास्त्राः with weapons and missiles, उत्तस्थुः rose up, रावणम् to Ravana, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रुवन् spoke
entries.32.28: भोः रावण O Ravana, साधु well said, साधु well said, युद्धस्य of battle, कालः the time, विज्ञेयः must be judged
entries.32.29: यः he who, क्षीबम् one who is drunk, स्त्रीवृतम् surrounded by women, नृपम् a king, योद्धुम् to fight, उत्सहते dares, स्त्रीसमक्षम् in the sight of women, वाशितामध्यगम् standing amid she-elephants, मत्तम् rutting, कुञ्जरम् an elephant, शार्दूलः इव like a tiger, अर्जुनम् Arjuna, कथम् how, योद्धुम् to fight, उत्सहसे do you dare
entries.32.30: दशग्रीव O ten-necked one, अद्य today, क्षमस्व forbear, त्वया by you, रजनी the night, चोष्यताम् let it be passed, युद्धे for battle, श्रद्धा eagerness, यदि if, अस्ति there is, तात good sir, श्वः tomorrow, समरे in combat, अर्जुनम् meet Arjuna
entries.32.31: यदि if, अद्य today, योद्धुम् to fight, मतिः the mind, अस्ति is set, युद्धतृष्णासमावृता filled with thirst for battle, अस्मान् us, निहत्य having slain, ततः then, अर्जुनेन with Arjuna, युद्धम् battle, उपयास्यसि you shall get
entries.32.32: ततः then, रावणामात्यैः by the ministers of Ravana, पार्थिवस्य of the king, ते those, अमात्याः ministers, युद्धे in the fight, सूदिताः were slain, चापि and also, बुभुक्षितैः by those hungry ones, भक्षिताः were devoured
entries.32.33: ततः then, अर्जुनस्य of Arjuna, अनुयातानाम् of the followers, रावणस्य of Ravana, मन्त्रिणाम् of the counsellors, हलहलाशब्दः a tumultuous uproar, नर्मदातीरे on the bank of the Narmada, आबभौ arose
entries.32.34: इषुभिः with arrows, तोमरैः with lances, शूलैः with spears, त्रिशूलैः with tridents, वज्रकर्षणैः with thunderbolt-like hooks, सरावणान् Ravana and his men, नर्दयन्तः roaring, समन्तात् from every side, समभिद्रुताः rushed upon them
entries.32.35: हैहयाधिपयोधानाम् of the warriors of the Haihaya lord, वेगः the onset, सुदारुणः exceedingly terrible, आसीत् was, सनक्रमीनमकरसमुद्रस्य इव like that of the ocean with its crocodiles and fish and makaras, निःस्वनः in its roar
entries.32.36: रावणस्य of Ravana, ते those, अमात्याः ministers, प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः Prahasta and Shuka and Sarana, क्रुद्धाः enraged, तेजसा by their fiery energy, कार्तवीर्यबलम् the army of Kartavirya, निर्दहन्ति स्म burned down
entries.32.37: अर्जुनाय to Arjuna, क्रीडमानाय who was sporting, समन्त्रिणः along with his counsellors, रावणस्य of Ravana, तत् that, कर्म deed, द्वाररक्षिभिः who guarded the gate, पुरुषैः by the men, कथितम् was reported
entries.32.38: श्रुत्वा having heard, न भेतव्यम् you must not fear, इति thus, तम् that, स्त्रीजनम् company of women, ततः then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, तस्मात् from that, जलात् water, गङ्गातोयात् from the water of the Ganga, अञ्जनः इव like Anjana the elephant, उत्ततार rose up
entries.32.39: ततः then, क्रोधदूषितनेत्रः his eyes inflamed with wrath, महाघोरः most terrible, सः that, अर्जुनपावकः Arjuna who was himself a fire, युगान्ते at the end of an age, पावकः इव like the fire, प्रजज्वाल blazed up
entries.32.40: वरहेमाङ्गदः wearing fine golden armlets, सः he, तूर्णतरम् most swiftly, गदाम् his mace, आदाय having taken up, तमांसि the darkness, दिवाकरः इव as the sun does, रक्षांसि the rakshasas, अभिदुद्राव rushed upon
entries.32.41: बाहुविक्षेपकरणाम् swung by the sweep of his arms, महागदाम् the great mace, समुद्यम्य having raised, गारुडम् of Garuda, वेगम् the speed, आस्थाय having assumed, सः that, अर्जुनः Arjuna, चापपात and swooped down
entries.32.42: विन्ध्यः the Vindhya, अर्कस्य of the sun, पर्वतः इव as a mountain does, तस्य his, मार्गम् path, समारुध्य having barred, विन्ध्यः इव like the Vindhya, अकम्प्यः immovable, मुसलायुधः armed with a pestle, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, स्थितः stood
entries.32.43: ततः then, महोद्धतः greatly aroused, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, क्रुद्धः enraged, अस्य at him, लोहबद्धम् bound about with iron, घोरम् dreadful, मुसलम् pestle, प्रेषयन् hurling, अम्बुदः यथा like a raincloud, ररास roared
entries.32.44: प्रहस्तकरमुक्तस्य released from the hand of Prahasta, तस्य its, मुसलस्य of the pestle, अग्रे at the tip, अशोकापीडसन्निभः like a wreath of ashoka blossoms, अग्निः a fire, प्रदहन् इव as if consuming, बभूव appeared
entries.32.45: अथ then, आयान्तम् coming on, मुसलम् the pestle, कार्तवीर्यः Kartavirya, तदा then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, सगदः mace in hand, अगदविक्रमः of unimpaired prowess, निपुणम् skilfully, वञ्चयामास evaded
entries.32.46: ततः then, हैहयाधिपः the lord of the Haihayas, पञ्चबाहुशतोच्छ्रयाम् five hundred arm-lengths in height, गुर्वीम् heavy, गदाम् mace, भ्रामयानः whirling, तम् that, प्रहस्तम् Prahasta, अभिदुद्राव rushed upon
entries.32.47: तथा thus, अतिवेगेन with tremendous force, गदया by the mace, हतः struck, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, तदा then, वज्रिवज्रहतः struck by the thunderbolt of its wielder, स्थितः standing, शैलः यथा as a mountain, निपपात fell
entries.32.48: प्रहस्तम् Prahasta, पतितम् fallen, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मारीचशुकसारणाः Maricha and Shuka and Sarana, समहोदरधूम्राक्षाः along with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, हि indeed, रणाजिरात् from the field of battle, अपसृष्टाः drew back
entries.32.49: अमात्येषु the ministers, अपक्रान्तेषु having retreated, प्रहस्ते Prahasta, वै indeed, निपातिते having been struck down, रावणः Ravana, तूर्णम् swiftly, नृपसत्तमम् best of kings, अर्जुनम् Arjuna, अभ्यद्रवत् charged
entries.32.50: तत्र there, सहस्रबाहोः of him of a thousand arms, विंशद्बाहोश्च and of him of twenty arms, नृपराक्षसयोः of the king and the rakshasa, दारुणम् terrible, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, तत् that, युद्धम् combat, आरब्धम् began
entries.32.51: संरब्धौ raging, सागरौ इव like two oceans, चलन्मूलौ अचलौ इव like two mountains with shifting bases, तेजोयुक्तौ आदित्यौ इव like two blazing suns, प्रदहन्तौ अनलौ इव like two consuming fires
entries.32.52: बलोद्धतौ swollen with strength, नागौ यथा like two elephants, वाशितार्थे for the sake of a cow, वृषौ यथा like two bulls, मेघौ इव like two clouds, विनर्दन्तौ bellowing, सिंहौ इव like two lions, बलोत्कटौ fierce in might
entries.32.53: तदा then, तौ those two, राक्षसार्जुनौ the rakshasa and Arjuna, क्रुद्धौ enraged, रुद्रकालौ इव like Rudra and Kala, परस्परम् each other, गदाभ्याम् with their maces, भृशम् violently, ताडयामासतुः struck
entries.32.54: अचलाः the mountains, घोरान् dreadful, वज्रप्रहारान् blows of the thunderbolt, यथा as, विषेहिरे endure them, तत्र there, तौ those two, नरराक्षसौ the man and the rakshasa, गदाप्रहारान् the blows of the maces, सेहाते bore
entries.32.55: यथा as, अशनिरवेभ्यः from the crash of the thunderbolt, प्रतिश्रुतिः an echo, जायते arises, तथा so, तयोः of those two, गदापोथैः by the battering of the maces, सर्वाः all, दिशः the quarters, प्रतिश्रुताः resounded
entries.32.56: अर्जुनस्य of Arjuna, सा that, गदा mace, अहितोरसि upon the chest of the foe, पात्यमाना being brought down, नभः the sky, काञ्चनाभम् golden-hued, चक्रे made, सौदामिनी विद्युत् यथा as lightning from a cloud
entries.32.57: तथैव just so, रावणेन by Ravana, अपि also, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, पात्यमाना brought down, अर्जुनोरसि on the chest of Arjuna, गदा the mace, महागिरौ upon a great mountain, उल्का इव like a meteor, निर्भाति shone forth
entries.32.58: अर्जुनः Arjuna, खेदम् weariness, न आयाति did not feel, राक्षसगणेश्वरः the lord of the rakshasa hosts, न च nor did he, तयोः of those two, इदम् this, युद्धम् combat, यथा as, पूर्वम् of old, बलीन्द्रयोः of Bali and Indra, आसीत् was
entries.32.59: वृषौ इव like two bulls, शृङ्गैः with their horns, अयुध्यन् they fought, कुञ्जरौ इव like two elephants, दन्ताग्रैः with the points of their tusks, तौ those two, नरराक्षससत्तमौ best of men and of rakshasas, परस्परम् each other, निघ्नन्तौ smiting
entries.32.60: ततः then, क्रुद्धेन by the enraged, अर्जुनेन Arjuna, सर्वप्राणेन with all his might, सा that, गदा mace, रावणस्य of Ravana, महोरसि upon the broad chest, स्तनयोः of the breasts, अन्तरे between, मुक्ता was let fly
entries.32.61: वरदानकृतत्राणे guarded by the grant of a boon, रावणोरसि on the chest of Ravana, सा that, गदा mace, दुर्बला इव as though feeble, यथावेगम् for all its force, द्विधा भूत्वा having broken in two, क्षितौ to the ground, अपतत् fell
entries.32.62: सः he, तु however, रावणः Ravana, अर्जुनप्रमुक्तेन loosed by Arjuna, गदापातेन by the fall of the mace, धनुर्मात्रम् the length of a bow, अपासर्पत् was driven back, निष्टनन् groaning, निषसाद sank down
entries.32.63: ततः then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, तदा then, विह्वलम् reeling, दशग्रीवम् the ten-necked one, आलक्ष्य having marked, सहसा suddenly, उत्पत्य having sprung up, गरुत्मान् इव as Garuda does, पन्नगम् a serpent, जग्राह seized him
entries.32.64: सः he, बलवान् the mighty, राजा king, बाहुसहस्रेण with his thousand arms, दशाननम् the ten-faced one, बलात् by force, गृह्य having caught, नारायणः यथा as Narayana did, बलिम् Bali, बबन्ध bound him
entries.32.65: दशग्रीवे the ten-necked one, बध्यमाने being bound, सिद्धचारणदेवताः the siddhas and charanas and gods, साधु इति वादिनः crying well done, अर्जुनमूर्धनि upon the head of Arjuna, पुष्पैः with flowers, किरन्ति showered
entries.32.66: व्याघ्रः a tiger, मृगम् a deer, इव as, आदाय having seized, मृगराट् the lion, दन्तिनम् इव as an elephant, हैहयः the Haihaya, राजा king, हर्षात् out of joy, अम्बुदवत् like a raincloud, मुहुः again and again, ननाद roared
entries.32.67: प्रहस्तः Prahasta, तु however, समाश्वस्तः having recovered, बद्धम् bound, दशाननम् the ten-faced one, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तैः those, राक्षसैः सह along with the rakshasas, क्रुद्धः enraged, पार्थिवम् the king, अभिदुद्राव rushed upon
entries.32.68: आपतताम् of those rushing on, तेषाम् of them, नक्तञ्चराणाम् night-rangers, वेगः the onset, आतपापाये at the passing of the hot season, अम्बुधौ over the ocean, उद्भूतः risen, पयोदानाम् इव like that of rain-clouds, बभौ appeared
entries.32.69: मुञ्च मुञ्च release him release him, इति thus, तिष्ठ तिष्ठ stand and stand, इति thus, असकृत् repeatedly, भाषन्तः shouting, तदा then, अर्जुने upon Arjuna, मुसलानि pestles, सशूलानि together with spears, उत्ससर्ज they hurled
entries.32.70: असम्भ्रान्तः unperturbed, अरिनिषूदनः destroyer of foes, अर्जुनः Arjuna, तदा then, अप्राप्तानि एव before ever they reached him, तानि those, अमरारीणाम् of the foes of the immortals, आयुधानि weapons, आशु swiftly, जग्राह caught
entries.32.71: ततः then, तैः एव with those very, दुर्धरैः irresistible, प्रवरायुधैः excellent weapons, रक्षांसि the rakshasas, भित्त्वा having pierced, वायुः the wind, अम्बुधरान् इव as it does the rain-clouds, विद्रावयामास scattered them
entries.32.72: तदा then, कार्तवीर्यः Kartavirya, अर्जुनः Arjuna, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, त्रासयित्वा having terrified, रावणम् Ravana, गृह्य taking with him, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by his friends, नगरम् the city, प्रविवेश entered
entries.32.73: द्विजैः by the twice-born, सपौरैः along with the citizens, कुसुमाक्षतोत्करैः with showers of flowers and unbroken rice, कीर्यमाणः being strewn, पुरुहूतसन्निभः resembling Indra, सः that, तदा then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, बलिम् Bali, निगृह्य having captured, सहस्रलोचनः इव like the thousand-eyed one, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, सम्प्रविवेश entered
entries.33.1: वायुग्रहणसन्निभम् like the seizing of the wind itself, तत् that, रावणग्रहणम् capture of Ravana, दिवि in heaven, दैवतैः by the gods, कथितम् spoken of, ततः then, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, शुश्राव heard
entries.33.2: ततः then, पुत्रकृतस्नेहात् out of affection for his son, कम्प्यमानः trembling, महाधृतिः of great firmness, महान् the great, ऋषिः sage, माहिष्मतीपतिम् the lord of Mahishmati, द्रष्टुम् to see, आजगाम came
entries.33.3: सः he, वायुतुल्यगतिः swift as the wind, द्विजः the twice-born, वायुमार्गम् the path of the wind, आस्थाय having taken, मनःसम्पातविक्रमः moving with the speed of thought, माहिष्मतीम् Mahishmati, पुरीम् the city, प्राप्तः reached
entries.33.4: सः he, अमरावतिसङ्काशाम् resembling Amaravati, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम् thronged with happy and thriving people, पुरीम् the city, ब्रह्मा Brahma, इन्द्रस्य of Indra, अमरावतीम् इव as into Amaravati, प्रविवेश entered
entries.33.5: पादचारम् going on foot, आदित्यम् इव like the sun, निष्पतन्तम् descending, सुदुर्दशम् hard to look upon, ततः then, ते they, प्रत्यभिज्ञाय having recognised him, अर्जुनाय to Arjuna, निवेदयन् made it known
entries.33.6: वचनात् from their words, पुलस्त्यः it is Pulastya, इति thus, विज्ञाय having learnt, हैहयाधिपः the lord of the Haihayas, शिरसि upon his head, अञ्जलिम् joined palms, आधाय having placed, तपस्विनम् the ascetic, प्रत्युद्गच्छत् went forth to meet
entries.33.7: अस्य his, पुरोहितः family priest, अर्घ्यम् the guest-offering, तथैव च and likewise, मधुपर्कम् the honey-mixture, गृह्य having taken up, शक्रस्य of Shakra, बृहस्पतिः इव like Brihaspati, राज्ञः of the king, पुरस्तात् in front, प्रययौ went
entries.33.8: ततः then, आयान्तम् approaching, उद्यन्तम् rising, भास्करम् इव like the sun, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, दृश्य having seen, अर्जुनः Arjuna, सम्भ्रान्तः in haste, ईश्वरम् the lord, इन्द्रः इव as Indra does, ववन्दे saluted
entries.33.9: सः he, राजेन्द्रः the lord of kings, तस्य to him, मधुपर्कम् the honey-mixture, गाम् a cow, पाद्यम् water for the feet, अर्घ्यम् the guest-offering, निवेद्य having presented, हर्षगद्गदया faltering with joy, गिरा in a voice, पुलस्त्यम् to Pulastya, आह said
entries.33.10: अद्य एव this very day, माहिष्मती Mahishmati, अमरावत्या to Amaravati, तुल्या equal, कृता has been made, द्विजेन्द्र O lord of the twice-born, यस्मात् since, अद्य today, अहम् I, दुर्दशम् hard to behold, त्वाम् you, पश्यामि see
entries.33.11: देव O god, अद्य today, मे my, कुशलम् welfare is complete, अद्य today, मे my, व्रतम् vow, कुशलम् has prospered, अद्य today, मे my, जन्म birth, सफलम् is fruitful, अद्य today, मे my, तपः austerity, सफलम् is fruitful, यस्मात् since, देवगणैः by the hosts of gods, वन्द्यौ worthy of worship, तव your, चरणौ feet, अहम् I, वन्दे salute
entries.33.12: इदम् this, राज्यम् kingdom, इमे these, पुत्राः sons, इमे these, दाराः wives, इमे these, वयम् we ourselves, ब्रह्मन् O brahmin, किम् what, कुर्मि shall I do, किम् what, कार्यम् is to be done, भवान् your honour, नः us, आज्ञापयतु let him command
entries.33.13: धर्मे about his religious duty, अग्निषु about his sacred fires, पुत्रेषु about his sons, शिवम् his welfare, पृष्ट्वा having enquired, तम् that, पार्थिवम् king, हैहयानाम् of the Haihayas, राजानम् the king, तथा likewise, अर्जुनम् Arjuna, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, उवाच addressed
entries.33.14: नरेन्द्र O lord of men, अम्बुजपत्राक्ष O lotus-petal-eyed one, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानन O you whose face is like the full moon, ते your, बलम् strength, अतुलम् is beyond compare, येन whereby, दशग्रीवः the ten-necked one, त्वया by you, जितः has been conquered
entries.33.15: यस्य of whom, भयात् out of fear, सागरानिलौ the ocean and the wind, निष्पन्दौ motionless, उपतिष्ठेताम् stood in attendance, सः he, अयम् this, रणदुर्जयः unconquerable in battle, मे my, पौत्रः grandson, मृधे in the fray, त्वया by you, बद्धः has been bound
entries.33.16: त्वया by you, पुत्रकस्य of my dear son, यशः the fame, पीतम् has been drunk up, नाम your name, विश्रावितम् has been spread abroad, अद्य now, मद्वाक्यात् at my word, याच्यमानः being entreated, वत्सम् the dear child, दशाननम् the ten-faced one, मुञ्च release
entries.33.17: अर्जुनः Arjuna, पुलस्त्याज्ञाम् the command of Pulastya, प्रगृह्य having accepted, किञ्चन any, वचः word, न ऊचे uttered not, पार्थिवेन्द्रः the lord of kings, प्रहृष्टवत् right gladly, राक्षसेन्द्रम् the lord of the rakshasas, वै indeed, मुमोच released
entries.33.18: सः that, अर्जुनः Arjuna, तम् that, त्रिदशारिम् foe of the gods, प्रमुच्य having released, दिव्याभरणस्रगम्बरैः with heavenly ornaments and garlands and garments, प्रपूज्य having honoured him, साग्निकम् before the sacred fire, अहिंसकम् free of enmity, सख्यम् friendship, उपेत्य having entered into, तम् that, ब्रह्मसुतम् son of Brahma, प्रणम्य having saluted, गृहम् to his own house, ययौ went
entries.33.19: पुलस्त्येन by Pulastya, अपि also, सन्त्यक्तः taken leave of, प्रतापवान् the mighty, राक्षसेन्द्रः lord of the rakshasas, परिष्वक्तः embraced, कृतातिथ्यः shown hospitality, विनिर्जितः vanquished, लज्जमानः and ashamed
entries.33.20: पितामहसुतः the son of the Grandsire, चापि and moreover, मुनिपुङ्गवः bull among sages, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, दशग्रीवम् the ten-necked one, मोचयित्वा having got him released, ब्रह्मलोकम् to the world of Brahma, जगाम ह went
entries.33.21: एवम् thus, सः that, महाबलः mighty one, रावणः Ravana, कार्तवीर्यात् at the hands of Kartavirya, प्रधर्षणम् humiliation, प्राप्तः met with, पुलस्त्यवचनात् by the word of Pulastya, चापि and also, पुनः again, मुक्तः was freed
entries.33.22: राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghavas, एवम् thus, बलिभ्यः than the strong, बलिनः stronger ones, सन्ति there are, यः he who, आत्मनः his own, प्रियम् good, इच्छेत् would desire, हि indeed, परे toward another, अवज्ञा contempt, न कार्या should never be shown
entries.33.23: ततः then, पिशिताशनानाम् of the flesh-eaters, सः that, राजा king, सहस्रबाहोः of him of a thousand arms, मैत्रीम् friendship, उपलभ्य having gained, पुनः again, नृपाणाम् of kings, कदनम् slaughter, चकार wrought, दर्पात् out of pride, सर्वाम् the whole, पृथिवीम् earth, चचार ranged over
entries.34.1: अर्जुनेन by Arjuna, विमुक्तः set free, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of the rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, तथा so, कृतः having been dealt with, अनिर्विण्णः undaunted, सर्वाम् the whole, पृथिवीम् earth, चचार ranged over
entries.34.2: अयम् this one, बलाधिकम् one of greater strength, राक्षसं वा whether a rakshasa, मनुष्यं वा or a man, शृणुते hears of, दर्पितः puffed with pride, रावणः Ravana, तम् him, समासाद्य having sought out, युद्धे to battle, ह्वयति challenges
entries.34.3: ततः then, कदाचित् on one occasion, वालिपालिताम् ruled by Vali, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkindha, नगरीम् city, गत्वा having gone to, हेममालिनम् wearer of the golden chain, वालिनम् Vali, युद्धाय to battle, ह्वयति challenged
entries.34.4: ततः then, वानरामात्यः the vanara minister, तारापिता the father of Tara, प्रभुः the mighty, तारः Tara, वानरः the vanara, युद्धप्रेप्सुम् desirous of battle, उपागतम् who had come, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke to
entries.34.5: राक्षसेन्द्र O lord of the rakshasas, यः who, ते your, प्रतिबलः a match, भवेत् might be, वाली Vali, गतः has gone out, तव your, प्रमुखतः before you, स्थातुम् to stand, शक्तः able, अन्यः other, कः what, प्लवङ्गमः monkey
entries.34.6: रावण O Ravana, चतुर्भ्यः from all four, समुद्रेभ्यः अपि oceans, सन्ध्याम् the twilight worship, अन्वास्य having performed, वाली Vali, इमम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, आयाति is coming, मुहूर्तकम् a little while, तिष्ठ wait
entries.34.7: राजन् O king, एतान् these, अस्थिचयान् heaps of bones, पश्य behold, ये which, एते these, शङ्खपाण्डुराः white as conch-shells, इमे these are, युद्धार्थिनाम् of those who came seeking battle, वानराधिपतेजसा by the might of the lord of the vanaras
entries.34.8: रावण O Ravana, राक्षस O rakshasa, यद्वा even if, अमृतरसः the draught of nectar, त्वया by you, पीतः has been drunk, तदा even then, वालिनम् Vali, आसाद्य having encountered, तदन्तम् that is the end of, तव your, जीवितम् life
entries.34.9: विश्रवसः of Vishravas, सुत O son, इदानीम् now, इमम् this, जगच्चित्रम् wonder of the world, पश्य behold, इदम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, तिष्ठस्व wait, ते for you, दुर्लभम् hard to come by, भविष्यति it will be
entries.34.10: अथवा or else, मर्तुम् to die, त्वरसे if you are in haste, दक्षिणसागरम् to the southern ocean, गच्छ go, तत्र there, भूमिस्थम् resting upon the ground, पावकम् इव like fire, वालिनम् Vali, द्रक्ष्यसे you shall see
entries.34.11: लोकरावणः the terror of the worlds, सः that, रावणः Ravana, तु then, तारम् Tara, विनिर्भर्त्स्य having rebuked, तत् that, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, समारुह्य having mounted, दक्षिणार्णवम् to the southern ocean, प्रययौ went
entries.34.12: तत्र there, हेमगिरिप्रख्यम् resembling the golden mountain, तरुणार्कनिभाननम् his face like the newly risen sun, सन्ध्योपासनतत्परम् intent upon the twilight worship, वालिनम् Vali, रावणः Ravana, दृष्ट्वा having seen
entries.34.13: अथ then, अञ्जनसन्निभः dark as collyrium, रावणः Ravana, पुष्पकात् from the Pushpaka, अवरुह्य having descended, तूर्णम् swiftly, वालिनम् Vali, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, निःशब्दपदम् with noiseless step, आव्रजत् advanced
entries.34.14: तदा then, यदृच्छया by chance, सः that, रावणः Ravana, वालिना by Vali, अपि also, दृष्टः was seen, पापाभिप्रायवान् bent upon an evil purpose, दृष्ट्वा having seen him, सम्भ्रमम् agitation, न तु चकार he showed none at all
entries.34.15: सिंहः a lion, शशम् a hare, आलक्ष्य having espied, वा or, गरुडः Garuda, पन्नगम् यथा as a serpent, वाली Vali, पापनिश्चयम् resolved on evil, तम् that, रावणम् Ravana, न चिन्तयति heeded not
entries.34.16: जिघृक्षमाणम् seeking to seize me, आयान्तम् coming on, पापचेतसम् evil-minded, रावणम् Ravana, कक्षावलम्बिनम् dangling under my arm, कृत्वा having made him, त्रीन् the three remaining, महार्णवान् great oceans, गमिष्ये I shall go to
entries.34.17: मम my, अङ्कस्थम् held at my side, स्रंसदूरुकराम्बरम् his thighs and arms and garment dangling loose, लम्बमानम् hanging, दशग्रीवम् the ten-necked one, अरिम् my foe, गरुडस्य of Garuda, पन्नगम् इव like the serpent, द्रक्ष्यन्ति they shall behold
entries.34.18: इत्येवम् in this wise, मतिम् his resolve, आस्थाय having settled upon, वाली Vali, कर्णम् उपाश्रितः his hand raised to his ear, नैगमान् vedic, मन्त्रान् mantras, जपन् वै murmuring, पर्वतराट् इव like the king of mountains, तस्थौ stood
entries.34.19: तौ those two, हरिराक्षसपार्थिवौ the vanara and rakshasa kings, अन्योन्यम् each other, जिघृक्षन्तौ seeking to seize, बलदर्पितौ proud of their strength, प्रयत्नवन्तौ straining every effort, तत् that, कर्म feat, ईहतुः strove after
entries.34.20: पादशब्देन by the sound of his footfall, तम् him, रावणम् Ravana, हस्तग्राहम् within reach of his hand, मत्वा having judged, पराङ्मुखः अपि though facing away, वाली Vali, अण्डजः a bird, सर्पम् इव as a serpent, जग्राह seized him
entries.34.21: ग्रहीतुकामम् who had meant to seize him, तम् that, रक्षसाम् of the rakshasas, ईश्वरम् lord, गृह्य having caught, हरिः the vanara, कक्षावलम्बिनम् dangling under his arm, कृत्वा having made him, वेगेन with speed, खम् into the sky, उत्पपात sprang up
entries.34.22: आपीडयमानम् though pressed hard, तु indeed, नखैः with his nails, मुहुः again and again, वितुदन्तम् tearing at him, तम् that, रावणम् Ravana, वाली Vali, पवनः the wind, तोयदं यथा as it does a rain-cloud, जहार bore away
entries.34.23: अथ then, ते those, राक्षसामात्याः ministers of the rakshasa, ह्रियमाणम् being carried off, दशाननम् the ten-faced one, मुमोक्षयिषवः wishing to rescue, रवमाणाः shouting, वालिम् after Vali, अभिद्रुताः rushed
entries.34.24: तैः by them, अन्वीयमानः being followed, वाली Vali, अम्बरमध्यगः moving in mid-air, मेघौघैः by masses of cloud, अन्वीयमानः attended, अम्बरस्थः set in the sky, अंशुमान् इव like the sun, भ्राजते shone
entries.34.25: ते they, राक्षसोत्तमाः the foremost rakshasas, वालिनम् Vali, सम्प्राप्तुम् to overtake, अशक्नुवन्तः being unable, तस्य his, बाहूरुवेगेन by the rush of his arms and thighs, परिश्रान्ताः exhausted, व्यवस्थिताः fell back
entries.34.26: गच्छतः of him as he went, वालिमार्गात् from the path of Vali, पर्वतेन्द्रः हि even a lord of mountains, अपाक्रामत् moved aside, मांसशोणितम् flesh and blood, बिभ्रत् वै bearing, जीवितप्रेप्सुः one who wishes to live, किं पुनः how much more
entries.34.27: अपक्षिगणसम्पातान् where no flocks of birds fly, महाजवः of great speed, वानरेन्द्रः the lord of the vanaras, क्रमशः in turn, सर्वान् all, सागरान् the oceans, सन्ध्याकालम् at the twilight hour, अवन्दत worshipped
entries.34.28: खैचरोत्तमः foremost among the sky-goers, वाली Vali, खैचरैः by the sky-going, भूतैः beings, सभाज्यमानः being honoured, सरावणः along with Ravana, पश्चिमम् the western, सागरम् ocean, हि indeed, आजगाम reached
entries.34.29: तस्मिन् there, वानरः the vanara, सन्ध्याम् the twilight rite, उपासित्वा having performed, स्नात्वा having bathed, जप्त्वा च and having murmured his prayers, दशाननम् the ten-faced one, वहमानः carrying, उत्तरम् the northern, सागरम् ocean, प्रायात् set out for
entries.34.30: महाहरिः the great vanara, बहुयोजनसाहस्रम् many thousands of yojanas, वहमानः bearing him, वायुवत् like the wind, मनोवत् च and like thought, शत्रुणा सह along with his foe, जगाम went
entries.34.31: उत्तरे in the northern, सागरे ocean, सन्ध्याम् the twilight rite, उपासित्वा having performed, दशाननम् the ten-faced one, वहमानः carrying, सः that, वाली Vali, वै indeed, पूर्वम् the eastern, महोदधिम् great ocean, अगमत् went to
entries.34.32: तत्र अपि there too, वासविः the son of Vasava, हरीश्वरः lord of the vanaras, सन्ध्याम् the twilight rite, अन्वास्य having performed, रावणम् Ravana, गृह्य carrying, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkindha, अभितः back toward, पुनः again, आगमत् returned
entries.34.33: वानरः the vanara, चतुर्षु in all four, समुद्रेषु अपि oceans, सन्ध्याम् the twilight rite, अन्वास्य having performed, रावणोद्वहनश्रान्तः wearied with carrying Ravana, किष्किन्धोपवने in the grove near Kishkindha, अपतत् alighted
entries.34.34: अथ then, कपिसत्तमः the best of monkeys, स्वकक्षात् from under his arm, रावणम् Ravana, मुमोच released, प्रहसन् laughing, मुहुः again and again, रावणम् to Ravana, कुतः whence, त्वम् are you, इति thus, उवाच said
entries.34.35: राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of the rakshasas, महत् great, विस्मयम् wonder, गत्वा having felt, श्रमलोलनिरीक्षणः his gaze unsteady with exhaustion, तम् that, हरीन्द्रम् lord of the vanaras, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.34.36: वानरेन्द्र O lord of the vanaras, महेन्द्राभ O peer of great Indra, अहम् I, राक्षसेन्द्रः lord of the rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, अस्मि am, युद्धेप्सुः desiring battle, इह here, सम्प्राप्तः have come, सः च and that, अद्य today, त्वया by you, आसादितः has been granted
entries.34.37: अहो how great, बलम् the strength, अहो how great, वीर्यम् the valour, गाम्भीर्यम् एव च and how great the gravity, येन whereby, अहम् I, पशुवत् like a beast, गृह्य having been seized, चतुरः the four, अर्णवान् oceans, भ्रामितः have been carried round
entries.34.38: वीर O hero, एवम् thus, अश्रान्तवत् as though unwearied, शीघ्रम् एव most swiftly, महार्णवान् the great oceans, माम् me, चैव and indeed, उद्वहमानः bearing, अन्यः another, कः what, वीरः hero, क्रमिष्यति will traverse
entries.34.39: प्लवङ्गम O leaping one, त्रयाणाम् of three, भूतानाम् एव beings alone, एषा this, गतिः is the course, मनोनिलसुपर्णानाम् of mind and wind and Suparna, अत्र herein, तव and yours, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.34.40: हरिपुङ्गव O bull among vanaras, सः that, अहम् I, दृष्टबलः having seen your strength, तुभ्यम् with you, त्वया सह in your company, चिरम् enduring, सुस्निग्धम् most affectionate, सख्यम् friendship, पावकाग्रतः before the fire, इच्छामि desire
entries.34.41: हरीश्वर O lord of the vanaras, दाराः wives, पुत्राः sons, पुरम् city, राष्ट्रम् realm, भोगाच्छादनभोजनम् enjoyments and raiment and food, सर्वम् एव everything, नौ for us both, अविभक्तम् undivided, भविष्यति shall be
entries.34.42: ततः then, अग्निम् the fire, प्रज्वालयित्वा having kindled, तौ those two, उभौ both, हरीराक्षसौ the vanara and the rakshasa, परस्परम् each other, परिष्वज्य having embraced, भ्रातृत्वम् brotherhood, उपसम्पन्नौ entered into
entries.34.43: ततः then, तौ those two, हरिराक्षसौ the vanara and the rakshasa, अन्योन्यम् about each other, लम्बितकरौ with arms laid, हृष्टौ delighted, सिंहौ two lions, गिरिगुहाम् इव as into a mountain cave, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkindha, विशतुः entered
entries.34.44: सः he, रावणः Ravana, सुग्रीवः इव like Sugriva, तत्र there, मासम् for a month, उषितः dwelt, त्रैलोक्योत्सादनार्थिभिः bent upon the ruin of the three worlds, आगतैः who had come, अमात्यैः by his ministers, नीतः was led away
entries.34.45: प्रभो O lord, एवम् thus, एतत् this, पुरावृत्तम् came to pass of old, रावणः Ravana, वालिना by Vali, धर्षितः was overpowered, पावकसन्निधौ in the presence of the fire, भ्राता a brother, कृतः चापि and was also made
entries.34.46: राम O Rama, वालिनः of Vali, बलम् the strength, अप्रतिमम् beyond compare, उत्तमम् supreme, अभवत् was, सः he, अपि even, त्वया by you, वह्निना by fire, शलभः यथा as a moth, विनिर्दग्धः was burnt up
entries.35.1: तदा then, रामः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, विनयोपेतः filled with humility, दक्षिणाशाश्रमम् whose hermitage lay in the southern quarter, मुनिम् the sage, अपृच्छत asked, अर्थवत् weighty with meaning, इदम् this, वचः word, आह spoke
entries.35.2: वालिनः of Vali, रावणस्य च and of Ravana, एतत् this, बलम् strength, अतुलम् वै is indeed beyond compare, तु but, एताभ्याम् to these two, हनुमता with Hanuman, समम् equal, न तु but not, इति such, मम my, मतिः is the opinion
entries.35.3: शौर्यम् heroism, दाक्ष्यम् skill, बलम् strength, धैर्यम् firmness, प्राज्ञता wisdom, नयसाधनम् mastery of policy, विक्रमश्च and valour, प्रभावश्च and majesty, हनूमति in Hanuman, कृतालयाः have made their home
entries.35.4: महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, सागरम् the ocean, दृष्ट्वैव as soon as he saw, सीदन्तीम् sinking in despair, कपिवाहिनीम् the vanara host, वीक्ष्य having beheld, समाश्वास्य having heartened them, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतम् a hundred, प्लुतः leapt
entries.35.5: तदा then, लङ्काम् Lanka, पुरीम् the city, धर्षयित्वा having overrun, रावणान्तःपुरम् the inner apartments of Ravana, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीता Sita, सम्भाषिता चापि was also spoken with, तथा and likewise, आश्वासिता हि was comforted
entries.35.6: सेनाग्रगाः the leaders of the army, मन्त्रिसुताः the sons of the ministers, किङ्कराः the Kinkaras, रावणात्मजः the son of Ravana, एते these, तत्र there, हि indeed, एकेन by him alone, हनुमता by Hanuman, विनिपातिताः were struck down
entries.35.7: भूयः again, बन्धात् from bondage, विमुक्तेन by him who freed himself, दशाननम् the ten-faced one, भाषयित्वा having made to speak, येन by whom, लङ्का Lanka, पावकेन by fire, मेदिनी इव as the earth is, भस्मीकृता was reduced to ashes
entries.35.8: युद्धे in battle, हनूमतः of Hanuman, यानि which, तानि those, कर्माणि deeds, श्रूयन्ते are heard of, न कालस्य not of Kala, न शक्रस्य not of Shakra, न विष्णोः not of Vishnu, वित्तपस्य च nor of the lord of wealth
entries.35.9: एतस्य his, बाहुवीर्येण by the might of his arms, लङ्का Lanka, सीता Sita, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, जयश्चैव and victory, राज्यम् kingdom, मित्राणि friends, बान्धवाः kinsmen, मया by me, प्राप्ता were gained
entries.35.10: हनूमान् Hanuman, यदि if, मे my, वानराधिपतेः of the lord of the vanaras, सखा friend, न स्यात् had not been, जानक्याः of Janaki, प्रवृत्तिम् अपि even tidings, वेत्तुम् to learn, कः who, शक्तिमान् able, भवेत् would have been
entries.35.11: सुग्रीवप्रियकाम्यया out of desire to please Sugriva, तदा then, वैरे when the enmity, समुत्पन्ने had arisen, अनेन एव by him alone, वाली Vali, वीरुधः यथा like a shrub, किमर्थम् why, न दग्धः was he not burnt up
entries.35.12: हनूमान् Hanuman, आत्मनः his own, बलम् strength, न हि वेदितवान् knew not at all, मन्ये I think, यत् since, जीवितेष्टम् dear to him as life, क्लिश्यन्तम् in distress, वानराधिपम् the lord of the vanaras, दृष्टवान् he saw
entries.35.13: भगवन् O venerable one, अमरपूजित O you honoured by the immortals, महामतौ of great mind, हनूमति concerning Hanuman, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, मे to me, विस्तरेण at length, यथातत्त्वम् as it truly is, कथय relate
entries.35.14: तदा then, ऋषिः the sage, राघवस्य of Raghava, हेतुयुक्तम् well reasoned, वचः speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, हनूमतः of Hanuman, समक्षम् in the presence, तम् to him, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.35.15: रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of the Raghus, हनूमतः of Hanuman, यत् what, ब्रवीषि you say, एतत् this, सत्यम् is true, बले in strength, तुल्यः an equal, न विद्यते there is none, न गतौ nor in swiftness, न मतौ nor in understanding, परः is any other
entries.35.16: पुरा long ago, अमोघशापैः whose curses never fail, मुनिभिः by the sages, अस्य upon him, शप्तः a curse, दत्तः was laid, येन whereby, बली mighty, सन् though being, अरिमर्दनः crusher of foes, बलम् his own strength, न वेत्ता हि knows not at all
entries.35.17: महाबल O mighty one, राम O Rama, बाल्ये अपि even in childhood, एतेन by him, यत् what, कर्म deed, कृतम् was done, तत् that, वर्णयितुम् to describe, न शक्यम् is not possible, इति thus, बालतया as a mere child, आस्यते it is passed over
entries.35.18: राघव O Raghava, यदि वा but if, तत् that, श्रोतुम् to hear, तव your, अभिप्रायः desire, अस्ति तु there is, राम O Rama, मतिम् your mind, समाधाय having composed, निशामय listen, अहम् I, वदामि shall tell it
entries.35.19: सूर्यदत्तवरस्वर्णः its gold granted as a boon by the sun, सुमेरुर्नाम Sumeru by name, पर्वतः a mountain, यत्र where, अस्य his, पिता father, केसरी नाम Kesari by name, वै indeed, राज्यम् the realm, प्रशास्ति rules
entries.35.20: तस्य his, भार्या wife, एषा she, अञ्जना इति as Anjana, परिश्रुता was renowned, बभूव was, तस्याम् वै upon her, वायुः the wind-god, उत्तमम् an excellent, आत्मजम् son, जनयामास begot
entries.35.21: तदा then, अञ्जना Anjana, शालिशूकनिभाभासम् shining like the awn of rice, अमुम् him, प्रासूत bore, फलानि fruits, आहर्तुकामा वै wishing to gather, गहनेचरा she who ranged the thickets, निष्क्रान्ता went out
entries.35.22: एषः he, मातुः from his mother, वियोगात् by separation, क्षुधया च and by hunger, भृशार्दितः sorely afflicted, शिशुः the infant, शरवणे in the reed-thicket, शिशुः यथा like the child born there, अत्यर्थम् most piteously, रुरोद wailed
entries.35.23: तदा then, जपापुष्पोत्करोपमम् like a mass of japa blossoms, उद्यन्तम् rising, विवस्वन्तम् the sun, ददर्श he saw, फललोभात् च and out of longing for a fruit, हि indeed, रविं प्रति toward the sun, उत्पपात sprang up
entries.35.24: बालार्काभिमुखः facing the young sun, बालः the child, मूर्तिमान् embodied, बालार्कः इव like the young sun itself, बालार्कम् that young sun, ग्रहीतुकामः wishing to seize, अम्बरमध्यगः coursing in mid-air, प्लवते flew
entries.35.25: एतस्मिन् when this, शिशुभावे in his infancy, हनूमति Hanuman, प्लवमाने was flying, देवदानवयक्षाणाम् of gods and danavas and yakshas, सुमहान् exceedingly great, विस्मयः amazement, अभूत् arose
entries.35.26: अयम् this, वायुपुत्रः son of the wind, तु indeed, यथा as, उत्तमम् the highest, अम्बरम् sky, क्रमते traverses, वायुः the wind, गरुडः वा or Garuda, तथा so, मनः thought, न अपि एवम् not even thus, वेगवान् is swift
entries.35.27: यदि if, अस्य of this, शिशोः child, तावत् even now, ईदृशः such, गतिविक्रमः is his power of motion, यौवनम् youth, बलम् strength, आसाद्य having attained, वेगः his speed, कथम् what, भविष्यति will it be
entries.35.28: वायुः the wind, प्लवन्तम् as he flew, आत्मनः his own, पुत्रम् son, सूर्यदाहभयात् from fear of burning by the sun, रक्षन् protecting, तुषारचयशीतलः cool as a mass of snow, तम् him, अनुप्लवते followed in flight
entries.35.29: एषः he, अम्बरम् the sky, गतः having entered, बहुयोजनसाहस्रम् many thousands of yojanas, क्रमति traversed, पितुः of his father, बलात् च by the strength, बाल्यात् च and by his childishness, भास्कराभ्याशम् close to the sun, आगतः came
entries.35.30: एषः this, शिशुः is a child, अदोषज्ञः तु and knows no wrong, इति thus, मत्वा having considered, अत्र herein, कार्यम् a purpose, समायत्तम् is bound up, इति thus, एवम् so, सः he, दिवाकरः the sun, न ददाह burned him not
entries.35.31: एषः he, यम् एव on that very, दिवसम् day, हि indeed, भास्करम् the sun, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, प्लुतः leapt, तम् एव on that very, दिवसम् day, राहुः Rahu, दिवाकरम् the sun, जिघृक्षति sought to seize
entries.35.32: राम O Rama, चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः crusher of the moon and the sun, राहुः Rahu, अनेन by him, सूर्यरथोपरि above the chariot of the sun, परामृष्टः was brushed aside, ततः thereupon, त्रस्तः terrified, अपक्रान्तः fled away
entries.35.33: सः he, सिंहिकासुतः the son of Simhika, सरोषः full of wrath, इन्द्रभवनम् to the abode of Indra, गत्वा having gone, भ्रुकुटिम् a frown, कृत्वा having made, देवगणैः by the hosts of gods, वृतम् surrounded, देवम् to the god, अब्रवीत् said
entries.35.34: वासव O Vasava, बलवृत्रहन् O slayer of Bala and Vritra, मम to me, बुभुक्षापनयम् for the appeasing of hunger, चन्द्रार्कौ the moon and the sun, दत्त्वा having given, इदम् this, तत् that, त्वया by you, अन्यस्य to another, दत्तम् has been given, किम् what does it mean
entries.35.35: अद्य today, अहम् I, पर्वकाले at the hour of conjunction, सूर्यम् the sun, जिघृक्षुः desiring to seize, आगतः came, अथ then, अन्यः another, राहुः Rahu, आसाद्य having come upon it, सहसा suddenly, रविम् the sun, जग्राह seized
entries.35.36: सः he, वासवः Vasava, राहोः of Rahu, वचनम् the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सम्भ्रमान्वितः filled with alarm, आसनम् his seat, हित्वा having quitted, काञ्चनीम् a golden, स्रजम् garland, उद्वहन् च and wearing, उत्पपात rose up
entries.35.37: ततः then, कैलासकूटाभम् resembling a peak of Kailasa, चतुर्दन्तम् four-tusked, मदस्रवम् streaming with rut, शृङ्गारधारिणम् bearing rich trappings, प्रांशुम् lofty, स्वर्णघण्टाट्टहासिनम् laughing loud with its golden bells
entries.35.38: इन्द्रः Indra, करीन्द्रम् that lordly elephant, आरुह्य having mounted, राहुम् Rahu, पुरःसरम् in front, कृत्वा having placed, यत्र where, सूर्यः the sun, अनेन with him, हनूमता Hanuman, सह along, अभवत् was, प्रायात् set out
entries.35.39: अथ then, राहुः Rahu, वासवम् Vasava, उत्सृज्य having outstripped, अतिरभसेन in great haste, अगात् went on, अनेन च and by this one, सः he, शैलकूटवत् like a mountain peak, प्रधावन् rushing on, वै indeed, दृष्टः was seen
entries.35.40: ततः then, सूर्यम् the sun, समुत्सृज्य having let go, राहुम् Rahu, फलम् as a fruit, अवेक्ष्य च and having eyed, सिंहिकासुतम् the son of Simhika, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, पुनः again, व्योम into the sky, उत्पपात sprang up
entries.35.41: राम O Rama, अर्कम् the sun, उत्सृज्य having let go, इमम् this, प्लवङ्गमम् monkey, प्रधावन्तम् rushing at him, अवेक्ष्य having seen, एवम् thereupon, परावृत्त्य having turned about, मुखशेषः with only his head left him, पराङ्मुखः turned to flee
entries.35.42: सिंहिकासुतः the son of Simhika, त्रातारम् as his protector, इन्द्रम् to Indra, आशंसमानः तु looking, संत्रासात् out of terror, इन्द्र इन्द्र इति O Indra O Indra, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अभाषत cried out
entries.35.43: विक्रोशमानस्य of him crying aloud, राहोः of Rahu, प्राक् एव even before this, आलक्षितम् well known, स्वरम् the voice, श्रुत्वा having heard, इन्द्रः Indra, उवाच said, मा भैषीः fear not, अहम् I, एनम् him, निषूदये shall strike down
entries.35.44: ततः then, ऐरावतम् Airavata, दृष्ट्वा having seen, इदम् this, महत् is a great one, तत् that, इति thus, अपि indeed, फलम् a fruit, मत्वा having supposed, मारुतिः the son of the wind, हस्तिराजम् at the king of elephants, अभिदुद्राव rushed
entries.35.45: तथा so, ऐरावतजिघृक्षया out of desire to seize Airavata, धावतः as he rushed, अस्य his, रूपम् form, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, इन्द्राग्न्योः इव like that of Indra and Agni, भास्वरम् blazing, घोरम् terrible, अभवत् became
entries.35.46: एवम् thus, आधावमानम् rushing upon him, तु indeed, शचीपतिः the lord of Shachi, नातिक्रुद्धः not greatly angered, हस्तान्तात् from his hand, अतिमुक्तेन loosed, कुलिशेन with the thunderbolt, अभ्यताडयत् struck him
entries.35.47: ततः then, इन्द्रवज्राभिताडितः struck by the thunderbolt of Indra, एषः he, गिरौ upon a mountain, पपात fell, पतमानस्य as he fell, एतस्य his, वामः left, हनुः jaw, अभज्यत was broken
entries.35.48: वज्रताडनविह्वले stunned by the stroke of the thunderbolt, तस्मिन् when that, बाले child, पतिते had fallen, सः he, पवनः the wind-god, प्रजानाम् of created beings, अहिताय to their harm, इन्द्राय against Indra, चुक्रोध raged
entries.35.49: सः he, प्रभुः the lord, मारुतः the wind, प्रचारम् his coursing, सङ्गृह्य having drawn in, प्रजासु within creatures, अन्तर्गतः having passed inward, स्वसुतम् his own son, शिशुम् the infant, आदाय having taken up, गुहाम् a cave, प्रविष्टः entered
entries.35.50: विण्मूत्राशयम् the seats of excretion, आवृत्य having blocked, प्रजानाम् of creatures, परमार्तिकृत् causing utmost distress, सर्वभूतानि all beings, रुरोध he stopped up, वासवः Vasava, वर्षाणि यथा as he does the rains
entries.35.51: वायुप्रकोपात् from the wrath of the wind, भूतानि creatures, सर्वतः on every side, निरुच्छ्वासानि without breath, सन्धिभिः their joints, भिद्यमानैः च and splitting apart, काष्ठभूतानि like blocks of wood, जज्ञिरे became
entries.35.52: वायुप्रकोपात् from the wrath of the wind, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारम् without recitation of the Veda or the vashat call, निष्क्रियम् without rite, धर्मवर्जितम् bereft of dharma, निरयस्थम् इव as though sunk in hell, अभवत् became
entries.35.53: ततः then, प्रजाः the creatures, सगन्धर्वाः with the gandharvas, सदेवासुरमानुषाः with gods and asuras and men, दुःखिताः afflicted, सुखेच्छया out of longing for relief, प्रजापतिम् to Prajapati, समाधावन् ran
entries.35.54: महोदरनिभोदराः their bellies grown large and hollow, देवाः the gods, प्राञ्जलयः with joined palms, ऊचुः said, भगवन् O venerable one, प्रजानाथ O lord of creatures, चतुर्विधाः of four kinds, प्रजाः the creatures, त्वया नु by you indeed, सृष्टाः were created
entries.35.55: सत्तम O best of beings, अस्माकम् for us, आयुषः of our life, पतिः the lord, अयम् this, पवनः wind, त्वया by you, दत्तः was given, सः he, अस्मान् for us, प्राणेश्वरः lord of the vital breath, भूत्वा having become, एषः he, अद्य today, कस्मात् for what cause
entries.35.56: दुःखम् suffering, जनयन् causing, अन्तःपुरे in the inner apartments, स्त्रियः इव as women are, रुरोध has shut us in, वायुना by the wind, उपहताः stricken, वयम् we, तस्मात् therefore, त्वाम् to you, शरणम् for refuge, प्राप्ताः have come
entries.35.57: प्रजानाथः the lord of creatures, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, प्रजानाम् of the creatures, एतत् this, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, कारणात् there is a cause for it, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, असौ he, प्रजाः to the creatures, पुनः again, अभाषत spoke
entries.35.58: प्रजाः O creatures, यस्मिन् for which, कारणे cause, वायुः the wind, चुक्रोध was enraged, रुरोध च and shut all in, तत् that, सर्वम् entirely, शृणुध्वम् hear, आत्मनः for your own selves, श्रोतव्यम् fit to be heard, क्षमम् च and proper
entries.35.59: तस्य his, पुत्रः son, अमरेशेन by the lord of the immortals, इन्द्रेण by Indra, अद्य today, निपातितः has been struck down, राहोः of Rahu, वचनम् the word, आस्थाय having acted upon, ततः thereupon, सः that, अनिलः wind, कुपितः was angered
entries.35.60: वायुः the wind, अशरीरः himself bodiless, शरीरेषु within bodies, पालयन् sustaining them, चरति moves, वायुम् the wind, विना without, शरीरम् the body, हि indeed, दारुभिः with logs of wood, समताम् parity, याति attains
entries.35.61: वायुः the wind, प्राणः is the vital breath, वायुः the wind, सुखम् is happiness, वायुः the wind, इदम् this, सर्वम् whole, जगत् world, वायुना by the wind, सम्परित्यक्तम् forsaken, जगत् the world, सुखम् happiness, न विन्दते finds not
entries.35.62: अद्य एव this very day, जगदायुषा by him who is the life of the world, वायुना by the wind, परित्यक्तम् च and it has been forsaken, अद्य एव this very day, ते they, निरुच्छ्वासाः without breath, काष्ठकुड्योपमाः like logs and walls, स्थिताः stand
entries.35.63: तत् therefore, यत्र where, मारुतः the wind, आस्ते abides, तत्र thither, यामः let us go, हि indeed, नः to us, रुक्प्रदः he gives pain, अदितेः of Aditi, सुताः O sons, अप्रसाद्य without appeasing him, विनाशम् destruction, मा गमिष्याम let us not go to
entries.35.64: ततः then, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, प्रजाभिः by the creatures, सहितः accompanied, सदेवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गगुह्यकैः with gods and gandharvas and serpents and guhyakas, यत्र where, सः that, मारुतः wind, सुरेन्द्राभिहतम् struck down by the lord of the gods, सुतम् his son, प्रगृह्य holding, आस्ति abides, तत्र thither, जगाम went
entries.35.65: ततः then, चतुर्मुखः the four-faced one, सदागतेः of the ever-moving wind, तदा then, उत्सङ्गगतम् resting in his lap, अर्कवैश्वानरकाञ्चनप्रभम् radiant as sun and fire and gold, सुतम् the son, वीक्ष्य having beheld, सदेवगन्धर्वर्षियक्षराक्षसैः along with gods and gandharvas and sages and yakshas and rakshasas, अथ then, कृपाम् compassion, अकरोत् showed
entries.36.1: ततः then, पुत्रवधार्दितः stricken by the slaying of his son, वायुः the wind, पितामहम् the Grandsire, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तम् that, शिशुकम् little child, समादाय taking up, धातुः of the creator, अग्रतः before, उत्तस्थौ stood up
entries.36.2: चलकुण्डलमौलिस्रक्तपनीयविभूषणः adorned with swinging earrings and diadem and garland and gold, वायुः the wind, तिस्रः three times, उपस्थाय having made obeisance, वेधसे to the ordainer, पादयोः at his feet, न्यपतत् fell down
entries.36.3: वेदविदा by him who knew the Vedas, लम्बाभरणशोभिना resplendent with pendant ornaments, तेन by him, तम् that, वायुम् wind-god, हस्तेन with his hand, उत्थाप्य having raised up, तम् that, शिशुम् infant, परिमृष्टवान् he stroked
entries.36.4: ततः then, सः that one, अथ then, पद्मयोनिना by the lotus-born, सलीलम् lightly, स्पृष्टमात्रः merely touched, जलसिक्तम् watered, सस्यम् यथा as a crop revives, पुनः again, जीवितम् life, आप्तवान् regained
entries.36.5: प्राणवन्तम् restored to life, इमम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्राणः the breath of life, गन्धवहः bearer of scents, मुदा with joy, सन्निरुद्धम् that had been pent up, पुरा यथा as before, सर्वभूतेषु among all beings, चचार moved
entries.36.6: मरुद्रोधात् from the stopping of the wind, विनिर्मुक्ताः released, ताः those, प्रजाः creatures, मुदिताः joyful, अभवन् became, शीतदाहविनिर्मुक्ताः freed from the blight of frost, साम्बुजाः with their lotuses, पद्मिन्यः इव like lotus-pools
entries.36.7: ततः then, त्रियुग्मः he of the three pairs, त्रिककुत् of three summits, त्रिधामा of three abodes, त्रिदशार्चितः worshipped by the thirty gods, ब्रह्मा Brahma, मारुतप्रियकाम्यया out of desire to please the wind, देवताः to the gods, उवाच spoke
entries.36.8: भोः O you, महेन्द्रेशवरुणप्रजेश्वरधनेश्वराः Mahendra and Isha and Varuna and the lord of creatures and the lord of wealth, वः to you, सर्वम् everything, जानताम् अपि though you know it, हितम् what is good, वक्ष्यामि I shall declare, श्रूयताम् let it be heard
entries.36.9: अनेन by this, शिशुना child, वः for you, कार्यम् a work, कर्तव्यम् to be done, भविष्यति there will be, तत् therefore, सर्वे all of you, अस्य to him, मारुतस्य of the wind, तुष्टये for the gratification, वरान् boons, वदध्वम् declare
entries.36.10: ततः then, सहस्रनयनः the thousand-eyed one, प्रीतियुक्तः filled with pleasure, शुभाननः his face serene, कुशेशयमयीम् made of lotuses, मालाम् a garland, उत्क्षिप्य having raised, इदम् this, वचः word, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.36.11: मत्करोत्सृष्टवज्रेण by the thunderbolt loosed from my hand, अस्य his, हनुः jaw, यथा since, हतः was struck, नाम्ना वै by name indeed, कपिशार्दूलः this tiger among monkeys, हनुमान् इति as Hanuman, भविता shall be
entries.36.12: अहम् I, अस्य to him, परमम् a supreme, अद्भुतम् wondrous, वरम् boon, प्रदास्यामि shall grant, इतः प्रभृति from this day forth, मम my, वज्रस्य by the thunderbolt, अवध्यः unslayable, भविष्यति he shall be
entries.36.13: तिमिरापहः dispeller of darkness, भगवान् the venerable, मार्तण्डः the sun, तु then, तत्र there, अब्रवीत् said, मदीयस्य of my own, अस्य to him, तेजसः splendour, शतिकाम् a hundredth, कलाम् part, ददामि I give
entries.36.14: यदा when, शास्त्राणि the sciences, अध्येतुम् to study, अस्य his, शक्तिः capacity, भविष्यति shall be, तदा then, अस्य to him, शास्त्रम् the science, दास्यामि I shall give, येन whereby, वाग्ग्मी eloquent, भविष्यति he shall become
entries.36.15: शास्त्रदर्शने in insight into the sciences, अस्य to him, सदृशः equal, कश्चित् anyone, न च भविता there shall not be, वरुणश्च and Varuna, वरम् a boon, प्रादात् granted, वर्षायुतशतेन अपि even in a hundred myriads of years, मत्पाशात् from my noose, उदकात् अपि or from water, अस्य for him, मृत्युः death, न भविष्यति shall not be
entries.36.16: यमः Yama, सन्तुष्टः well pleased, दण्डात् from my rod, अवध्यत्वम् immunity from death, नित्यशः perpetual, अरोगत्वं च and freedom from disease, संयुगे in battle, अविषादं च and freedom from despondency, वरम् as a boon, ददामि I grant
entries.36.17: इयम् this, मामिका my own, गदा mace, संयुगेषु in battles, एनम् him, न वधिष्यति shall not slay, इति thus, एवम् so, तदा then, एकाक्षिपिङ्गलः the one of the single tawny eye, वरदः granting a boon, प्राह हि declared
entries.36.18: अयम् he, मत्तः from me, मदायुधानां च and from my weapons, न वध्यः not to be slain, भविष्यति shall be, इति thus, एवम् so, शङ्करेण by Shankara, अपि also, अस्य to him, परमः a supreme, वरः boon, दत्तः was given
entries.36.19: अयम् he, सर्वेषाम् of all, ब्रह्मदण्डानाम् rods of Brahma, अवध्यः unslayable, भविष्यति shall be, दीर्घायुः च long-lived, महात्मा च and great-souled, इति thus, ब्रह्मा Brahma, वचः the word, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.36.20: शिल्पिनाम् among craftsmen, प्रवरः the foremost, महामतिः of great mind, विश्वकर्मा च and Vishvakarma, बालसूर्योपमम् like the newly risen sun, एनम् this, शिशुम् child, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अस्य to him, वरम् a boon, प्रादात् granted
entries.36.21: संयुगे in battle, मत्कृतानि wrought by me, यानि which, दिव्यानि divine, शस्त्राणि weapons, तैः by them, अवध्यत्वम् immunity from death, आपन्नः having obtained, चिरजीवी long of life, भविष्यति he shall be
entries.36.22: ततः then, सुराणाम् of the gods, वरैः with the boons, अलङ्कृतम् adorned, एनम् him, दृष्ट्वा हि having seen, जगद्गुरुः the preceptor of the world, चतुर्मुखः the four-faced one, तुष्टमनाः well pleased in mind, वायुम् to the wind, आह said
entries.36.23: मारुत O Maruta, तव your, पुत्रः son, मारुतिः the son of the wind, अमित्राणाम् to foes, भयकरः a cause of terror, मित्राणाम् to friends, अभयङ्करः a giver of safety, अजेयः unconquerable, भविता shall be
entries.36.24: कामरूपः taking any form at will, कामचारी roving at will, कामगः going where he pleases, प्लवताम् among those who leap, वरः the best, अव्याहतगतिः of unobstructed course, भवति he is, कीर्तिमान् च and renowned, भविष्यति he shall become
entries.36.25: एषः he, संयुगे in battle, रावणोत्सादनार्थानि serving the destruction of Ravana, रामप्रियकरणि च and pleasing to Rama, रोमहर्षकराणि hair-raising, कर्माणि deeds, कर्ता shall perform
entries.36.26: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तम् that, मारुतम् wind-god, आमन्त्र्य having taken leave of, अमरैः सह along with the immortals, पितामहपुरोगमाः led by the Grandsire, सर्वे all, यथागतम् as they had come, ययुः departed
entries.36.27: सः he, अपि also, गन्धवहः bearer of scents, पुत्रम् his son, प्रगृह्य taking up, गृहम् home, आनयत् brought him, विनिर्गतः having gone forth, अञ्जनायाः to Anjana, वरदत्तम् the boons that had been granted, तम् that, आचख्यौ recounted
entries.36.28: राम O Rama, एषः he, वरान् the boons, प्राप्य having obtained, वरदानसमन्वितः endowed with those gifts, आत्मनि within himself, संस्थेन abiding, बलेन with strength, अर्णवः यथा as the ocean does, अपूर्यत was filled
entries.36.29: तदा then, तरसा with vigour, पूर्यमाणः अपि growing ever fuller, वानरपुङ्गवः the bull among vanaras, निर्भयः fearless, महर्षीणाम् of the great sages, आश्रमेषु in the hermitages, अपराध्यति committed offences
entries.36.30: अयम् he, स्रुग्भाण्डानि the sacrificial ladles and vessels, अग्निहोत्रं च and the sacred fire, वल्कलाजिनसञ्चयान् the stores of bark garments and deerskins, संशान्तानाम् of those tranquil ones, भग्नविच्छिन्नविध्वस्तान् broken and torn and scattered, करोति made
entries.36.31: महाबलः the mighty one, एवंविधानि of this kind, कर्माणि deeds, प्रावर्तत set about, शम्भुना by Shambhu, सर्वेषाम् of all, ब्रह्मदण्डानाम् rods of Brahma, अवध्यः unslayable, कृतः having been made
entries.36.32: ऋषयः the sages, जानन्तः knowing this, तम् वै him indeed, तस्य his, शक्तितः according to their power, सहन्ते bore with
entries.36.33: सः that, अञ्जनासुतः son of Anjana, वानरः vanara, केसरिणा by Kesari, वायुना by the wind-god, यथा though, प्रतिषिद्धः अपि forbidden, मर्यादाम् the bounds, लङ्घयति एव transgressed all the same
entries.36.34: रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of the Raghus, ततः then, भृग्वङ्गिरसवंशजाः born in the lines of Bhrigu and Angiras, महर्षयः the great sages, क्रुद्धाः angered, नातिक्रुद्धातिमन्यवः yet not carried away by excess of wrath, एनम् him, शेपुः cursed
entries.36.35: प्लवङ्गम O leaping one, यत् which, बलम् strength, समाश्रित्य relying upon, अस्मान् us, बाधसे you harass, तत् that, दीर्घकालम् for a long time, न वेत्तासि you shall not know, अस्माकम् by our word, शापमोहितः bewildered by the curse, यदा when, ते your, कीर्तिः glory, स्मार्यते is called to mind, तदा then, ते your, बलम् strength, वर्धते grows
entries.36.36: ततः then, महर्षिवचनौजसा by the force of the great sages' word, सः he, हृततेजौजाः his splendour and vigour taken from him, एषः he, तानि those, एव very, आश्रमाणि hermitages, मृदुभावम् a gentle temper, गतः having assumed, अचरत् moved among
entries.36.37: अथ then, ऋक्षरजसो नाम Riksharajas by name, वालिसुग्रीवयोः of Vali and Sugriva, पिता the father, तेजसा in splendour, भास्करप्रभः bright as the sun, सर्ववानरराजा king of all the vanaras, आसीत् was
entries.36.38: सः he, ऋक्षरजा नाम Riksharajas by name, हरीश्वरः lord of the vanaras, वानराणाम् over the vanaras, राज्यम् the kingship, चिरम् for long, कृत्वा having held, सः he, कालधर्मेण with the law of time, सङ्गतः met
entries.36.39: तस्मिन् when he, अस्तमिते had set, अथ then, मन्त्रकोविदैः skilled in counsel, मन्त्रिभिः by the ministers, वाली Vali, पित्र्ये of his father, पदे in the place, कृतः was installed, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वालिनः of Vali, पदे in the place
entries.36.40: अस्य his, सुग्रीवेण समम् with Sugriva, अद्वैधम् without division, छिद्रवर्जितम् free of flaw, आबाल्यम् from childhood, सख्यम् friendship, अभवत् was, अनिलस्य of the wind, अग्निना यथा as with fire
entries.36.41: एषः he, शापवशात् एव by force of the curse alone, आत्मनः his own, बलम् strength, न वेद knew not, राम O Rama, यदा when, वालिसुग्रीवयोः between Vali and Sugriva, वैरम् enmity, समुत्थितम् had arisen
entries.36.42: राम O Rama, एषः this, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वालिना by Vali, भ्राम्यमाणः अपि though driven about, न हि could not be helped
entries.36.43: देव O lord, एषः this, मारुतिः son of the wind, आत्मनि in himself, बलम् the strength, न हि जानाति knew not at all, तदा then, एषः this, कपिसत्तमः best of monkeys, ऋषिशापाहृतबलः his strength taken away by the sages' curse
entries.36.44: रणे in battle, कुञ्जररुद्धः hemmed in by an elephant, सिंहः वा or like a lion, सहितः held in check, आस्थितः stood
entries.36.45: पराक्रमोत्साहमतिप्रतापसौशील्यमाधुर्यनयानयैश्च in prowess and energy and understanding and majesty and good conduct and sweetness and knowledge of policy, गाम्भीर्यचातुर्यसुवीर्यधैर्यैः in gravity and cleverness and valour and fortitude, हनूमतः than Hanuman, लोके in the world, कः who, अभ्यधिकः greater, अस्ति is there
entries.36.46: असौ he, कपीन्द्रः lord of monkeys, अप्रमेयः immeasurable, पुनः again, व्याकरणम् grammar, ग्रहीष्यन् meaning to master, सूर्योन्मुखः facing the sun, प्रष्टुमनाः minded to question him, महत् a great, ग्रन्थम् text, धारयन् bearing, उद्यद्गिरेः from the mountain of sunrise, अस्तगिरिम् to the mountain of setting, जगाम went
entries.36.47: कपीन्द्रः the lord of monkeys, ससूत्रवृत्त्यर्थपदम् with its rules and commentary and glosses of meaning, महार्थम् of deep import, ससङ्ग्रहम् with its compendium, वै indeed, साद्ध्यति masters it, अस्य to him, कश्चित् anyone, सदृशः equal, शास्त्रे in learning, वैशारदे in expertise, छन्दगतौ in prosody, तथैव and likewise, न हि अस्ति there is none
entries.36.48: सर्वासु in all, विद्यासु branches of knowledge, तपोविधाने in the practice of austerity, अयम् he, सुराणाम् of the gods, गुरुम् the preceptor, हि indeed, प्रस्पर्धते rivals, सः that, अयम् this, नवव्याकरणार्थवेत्ता knower of the sense of the nine grammars, ते your, प्रसादात् by the grace, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अपि even, भविष्यति shall become
entries.36.49: प्रवीविवक्षोः of one about to burst forth, सागरस्य इव like the ocean, लोकान् the worlds, दिधक्षोः wishing to burn, पावकस्य इव like the fire, युगक्षये at the dissolution of an age, अन्तकस्य of Death, यथा एव even as, हनूमतः of Hanuman, पुरस्तात् in front, कः who, स्थास्यति will stand
entries.36.50: राम O Rama, एषः एव this very one, अन्ये च and the other, महाकपीन्द्राः great lords of monkeys, सुग्रीवमैन्दद्विविदाः Sugriva and Mainda and Dvivida, सनीलाः together with Nila, सतारतारेयनलाः with Tara and the son of Tara and Nala, सरम्भाः with Rambha, त्वत्कारणात् for your sake, सुरैः हि by the gods indeed, सृष्टाः were created
entries.36.51: यत् what, माम् me, त्वम् you, परिपृच्छसि ask, तत् that, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, कथितम् has been told, हनूमतः of Hanuman, बालभावे in his childhood, एतत् this, कर्म deed, मया by me, कथितम् has been recounted
entries.36.52: अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, कथितम् what was told, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, सौमित्रिः एव च and Saumitri too, राक्षसैः सह along with the rakshasas, वानराः the vanaras, परमम् the utmost, विस्मयम् amazement, जग्मुः were filled with
entries.36.53: अगस्त्यः Agastya, तु then, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् said, राम O Rama, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, त्वया by you, श्रुतम् has been heard, दृष्टः you have been seen, सम्भाषितः चासि and spoken with, वयम् we, गच्छामहे take our leave
entries.36.54: उग्रतेजसः of fierce splendour, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, एतत् this, वाक्यम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Raghava, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, प्रणतः चापि and bowing low, महर्षिम् to the great sage, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said
entries.36.55: अद्य today, मे my, देवताः deities, हृष्टाः are gladdened, पितरः the fathers, प्रपितामहाः the forefathers, युष्माकम् of you, दर्शनात् एव by the very sight, सबान्धवाः along with my kinsmen, नित्यम् ever, तुष्टाः are contented
entries.36.56: आगतस्पृहः with a longing come upon me, यत् what, वदामि I say, एतत् हि this indeed, मम my, विज्ञाप्यम् request, तु and, तत् that, भवद्भिः by your honours, मम कृते for my sake, अनुकम्पया out of compassion, कर्तव्यम् should be done
entries.36.57: पौरजानपदान् the townsfolk and country folk, स्वकार्येषु in their own affairs, स्थाप्य having settled, अहम् I, आगतः have come, सताम् of the good, भवताम् of your honours, प्रभावात् by the power, क्रतून् एव sacrifices indeed, करिष्यामि I shall perform
entries.36.58: महावीर्याः O mighty ones, भवन्तः your honours, मम my, यज्ञेषु at the sacrifices, सदस्याः members of the assembly, नित्यम् एव always, तत् therefore, मम to me, अनुग्रहकाङ्क्षिणः desiring to show favour, भविष्यथ shall be
entries.36.59: अहम् I, तपोनिर्धूतकल्मषान् whose sins are shaken off by austerity, युष्मान् you, समाश्रित्य having taken refuge in, पितृभिः by the fathers, अनुग्रहीतः favoured, सुनिर्वृतः wholly at peace, भविष्यामि shall become
entries.36.60: तत् therefore, भवद्भिः by your honours, सङ्गतैः gathered together, अनिशम् unceasingly, इह here, आगन्तव्यम् you should come, अगस्त्याद्याः headed by Agastya, संशितव्रताः of strict vows, ऋषयः तु the sages, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard
entries.36.61: तम् to him, एवमस्तु so be it, इति च and thus, उक्त्वा having said, प्रयातुम् to depart, उपचक्रमुः set about
entries.36.62: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, ते those, सर्वे all, ऋषयः sages, यथागतम् as they had come, गताः went, राघवश्च and Raghava, विस्मितः filled with wonder, तम् एव that very, अर्थम् matter, चिन्तयामास pondered upon
entries.36.63: ततः then, भास्करे the sun, अस्तम् to its setting, याते having gone, नृपवानरान् the kings and the vanaras, विसृज्य having dismissed, नरवरोत्तमः the best among the best of men, तदा then, विधिवत् according to rule, सन्ध्याम् the twilight rite, उपास्य having performed, रजन्याम् when the night, प्रवृत्तायाम् had set in, सः he, अन्तःपुरचरः one who moves in the inner apartments, अभवत् became
entries.37.1: धर्मेण in righteousness, विदितात्मनि of well-known self, काकुत्स्थे when Kakutstha, अभिषिक्ते had been consecrated, पौराणाम् of the citizens, हर्षवर्धिनी increasing the joy, या which, पूर्वा first, निशा night, व्यतीता passed away
entries.37.2: तस्याम् when that, रजन्याम् night, व्युष्टायाम् had brightened into dawn, प्रातः at daybreak, नृपतिबोधकाः the wakers of the king, सौम्याः gentle, वन्दिनः bards, नृपतिवेश्मनि in the palace of the king, समुपातिष्ठन् stood in attendance
entries.37.3: ते they, सर्वे all, रक्तकण्ठिनः sweet of voice, किन्नराः इव like kinnaras, शिक्षिताः trained, सम्प्रहर्षिणः filled with gladness, वीरम् the heroic, नृपतिम् king, यथावत् fittingly, तुष्टुवुः praised
entries.37.4: वीर O hero, सौम्य O gentle one, कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धन O increaser of the joy of Kausalya, प्रबुध्यस्व awake, नराधिप O ruler of men, त्वयि when you, सुप्ते are asleep, सर्वम् the whole, जगत् हि world indeed, स्वपिति sleeps
entries.37.5: ते your, विक्रमः valour, विष्णोः यथा is as that of Vishnu, रूपम् चैव and your beauty, अश्विनोः इव as of the Ashvins, बुद्ध्या in wisdom, बृहस्पतेः to Brihaspati, तुल्यः equal, प्रजापतिसमः the peer of Prajapati, हि indeed, असि you are
entries.37.6: ते your, क्षमा forbearance, पृथिवीतुल्या is like the earth, तेजसा in splendour, भास्करोपमः you are like the sun, ते your, वेगः swiftness, वायुना तुल्यः is equal to the wind, गाम्भीर्यम् your depth, उदधेः इव is as of the ocean
entries.37.7: स्थाणुः यथा like Sthanu, अप्रकम्प्यः unshakable, चन्द्रे in the moon, ईदृशम् such, सौम्यत्वम् is the gentleness, नराधिप O ruler of men, पूर्वम् before this, ईदृशाः such, पार्थिवाः kings, न भवितारः there have not been
entries.37.8: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, यथा seeing that, त्वम् you, अतिदुर्धर्षः are unassailable, धर्मनित्यः ever devoted to dharma, प्रजाहितः intent on the good of your subjects, कीर्तिश्च fame, लक्ष्मीश्च and fortune, त्वाम् you, न जहाति forsake not
entries.37.9: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, श्रीश्च prosperity, धर्मश्च and dharma, त्वयि in you, नित्यम् ever, प्रतिष्ठितौ are established, एताः these, चान्याः and other, मधुराः sweet praises, वन्दिभिः by the bards, परिकीर्तिताः were sung
entries.37.10: सूताश्च and the sutas, दिव्यैः with heavenly, संस्तवैः hymns of praise, राघवम् Raghava, बोधयन्ति स्म awakened, स्तूयमानाभिः as they were being sung, स्तुतिभिः by the praises, राघवः Raghava, प्रत्यबुध्यत awoke
entries.37.11: सः he, पाण्डराच्छादनास्तृतम् spread with white coverings, तत् that, शयनम् couch, विहाय having left, हरिः the tawny one, नारायणः यथा as Narayana does, नागशयनात् from the serpent couch, उत्तस्थौ rose
entries.37.12: उत्थितम् risen, तम् that, महात्मानम् great-souled one, प्रह्वाः bowing, प्राञ्जलयः with joined palms, नराः men, शुभ्रैः in bright, भाजनैः vessels, सलिलम् water, सहस्रशः by the thousand, उपतस्थुः brought before him
entries.37.13: कृतोदकशुचिः purified by the water rite, भूत्वा having become, काले at the due time, हुतहुताशनः having made oblation into the fire, पुण्यम् holy, इक्ष्वाकुसेवितम् served by the Ikshvakus, देवागारम् the shrine of the gods, आशु swiftly, जगाम went to
entries.37.14: तत्र there, देवान् the gods, पितॄन् the fathers, विप्रान् the brahmins, यथाविधि according to rule, अर्चयित्वा having worshipped, रामः Rama, जनैः by people, वृतः surrounded, बाह्यकक्षान्तरम् into the outer court, निर्जगाम came forth
entries.37.15: महात्मानः great-souled, वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः headed by Vasishtha, सपुरोहिताः with the family priests, मन्त्रिणः the counsellors, सर्वे all, दीप्यमानाः इव as though blazing, अग्नयः fires, उपतस्थुः attended upon him
entries.37.16: महात्मानः great-souled, नानाजनपदेश्वराः lords of various realms, क्षत्रियाश्च and kshatriyas, रामस्य of Rama, पार्श्वे at the side, शक्रस्य of Shakra, अमराः यथा इव just as the immortals do, उपाविशन् took their seats
entries.37.17: अत्र here, भरतः Bharata, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, महायशाः of great renown, शत्रुघ्नश्च and Shatrughna, हृष्टाः joyful, अध्वरम् upon a sacrifice, वेदाः the Vedas, त्रयः इव as the three do, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे waited upon him
entries.37.18: किङ्कराः the attendants, प्राञ्जलयः with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, मुदिताननाः their faces glad, याताः came, पार्श्वस्थाः standing at his side, मुदिता नाम right joyful, बहवः many, समुपाविशन् sat down
entries.37.19: महावीर्याः of great valour, कामरूपिणः taking any form at will, महौजसः of great might, सुग्रीवप्रमुखाः headed by Sugriva, विंशतिः twenty, वानराश्च vanaras, रामम् upon Rama, उपासन्ते attended
entries.37.20: विभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, चतुर्भिः by four, रक्षोभिः rakshasas, परिवारितः attended, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, धनेशम् upon the lord of wealth, गुह्यकाः इव as the guhyakas do, उपासते waited upon
entries.37.21: तथा likewise, निगमवृद्धाश्च elders learned in scripture, ये such, कुलीनाः च and well-born, मानवाः men, विचक्षणाः discerning, शिरसा with their heads, आवन्द्य having saluted, राजानम् the king, उपासन्ते attended upon him
entries.37.22: तथा so, परिवृतः surrounded, राजा the king, श्रीमद्भिः illustrious, ऋषिभिः by sages, वृतः encircled, महावीर्यैः of great valour, राजभिश्च and by kings, सराक्षसैः with the rakshasas, वानरैश्च and by the vanaras
entries.37.23: यथा as, देवेश्वरः the lord of the gods, नित्यम् ever, ऋषिभिः by sages, समुपास्यते is waited upon, तेन by that, रूपेण in appearance, अधिकः surpassing, सहस्राक्षात् beyond the thousand-eyed one, विरोचते he shone
entries.37.24: समुपविष्टानाम् as they sat together, तेषाम् among them, पुराणज्ञैः by those versed in ancient lore, महात्मभिः by the great-souled, धर्मसंयुक्ताः bound up with dharma, ताः ताः many and various, सुमधुराः most sweet, कथाः tales, कथ्यन्ते were told
